We want to admire the waves, and they drag us off to inspect the last new villa: we like the beach, and they bid us enjoy the gardens, brought every spring in lace-paper out of the florist's shop.

arxiv-2101-05266.title: Multiple crossing of Landau levels of two-dimensional fermions in double HgTe quantum wells
arxiv-2101-05266.creator: G. M. Gusev, 1 E. B. Olshanetsky, 2 F. G. G. Hernandez, 1 O. E. Raichev, 3 N. N. Mikhailov, 2 and S. A. Dvoretsky 2
arxiv-2101-05266.description: Abstract The double quantum well systems consisting of two HgTe layers separated by a tunnel-transparent barrier are expected to manifest a variety of phase states including two-dimensional gapless semimetal and two-dimensional topological insulator. The presence of several subbands in such systems leads to a rich filling factor diagram in the quantum Hall regime.

arxiv-2303-10127.title: Semicontraction and Synchronization of Kuramoto-Sakaguchi Oscillator Networks
arxiv-2303-10127.creator: Robin Delabays, Francesco Bullo
arxiv-2303-10127.description: Abstract This paper studies the celebrated Kuramoto-Sakaguchi model of coupled oscillators adopting two recent concepts. First, we consider appropriately-defined subsets of the n n -torus called winding cells. Second, we analyze the semicontractivity of the model, i.e., the property that the distance between trajectories decreases when measured according to a seminorm.

arxiv-2307-11160.title: Time-optimal multi-qubit gates: Complexity, efficient heuristic and gate-time bounds
arxiv-2307-11160.creator: P. Baßler, M. Heinrich, M. Kliesch
arxiv-2307-11160.description: Abstract Multi-qubit entangling interactions arise naturally in several quantum computing platforms and promise advantages over traditional two-qubit gates. In particular, a fixed multi-qubit Ising-type interaction together with single-qubit 𝖷 \operatorname{\mathsf{X}} -gates can be used to synthesize global 𝖹𝖹 \operatorname{\mathsf{ZZ}} -gates ( 𝖦𝖹𝖹 \operatorname{\mathsf{GZZ}} gates).

arxiv-2411-00692.title: Adaptive Node Positioning in Biological Transport Networks
arxiv-2411-00692.creator: Albert Alonso, Lars Erik J. Skjegstad, Julius B. Kirkegaard
arxiv-2411-00692.description: Abstract Biological transport networks are highly optimized structures that ensure power-efficient distribution of fluids across various domains, including animal vasculature and plant venation. Theoretically, these networks can be described as space-embedded graphs, and rich structures that align well with observations emerge from optimizing their hydrodynamic energy dissipation.

arxiv-2512-19803.title: Multiple Mellin-Barnes integrals with polygamma functions
arxiv-2512-19803.creator: Sumit Banik, Samuel Friot
arxiv-2512-19803.description: Abstract Mellin-Barnes (MB) integrals appear in various branches of physics and mathematics and are, in particular, used as a standard tool for evaluating multi-loop, multi-scale Feynman integrals both analytically and numerically. Recent geometric approaches based on conic hulls and triangulations provide a systematic framework for computing multiple MB integrals in terms of multivariate series.

arxiv-2601-19875.title: Mass, staticity, and a Riemannian Penrose inequality for weighted manifolds
arxiv-2601-19875.creator: Stephen McCormick
arxiv-2601-19875.description: Abstract . In this note, we show that the weighted mass of Baldauf and Ozuch [ 1 ] can be derived as a natural geometric mass invariant following Michel [ 10 ] , for a certain weighted curvature map. An associated weighted centre of mass definition is also derived from this.

pmc-11492887.title: Genetic associations of visfatin polymorphisms with clinicopathologic characteristics of prostate cancer in Taiwanese males
pmc-11492887.creator: Sung-Lin Hu, Shan-Chi Liu, Chia-Yen Lin, Yi-Chin Fong, Shian-Shiang Wang, Li-Chai Chen, Shun-Fa Yang, Chih-Hsin Tang
pmc-11492887.description: The most general cancer in men is prostate cancer (PCa), with its risk increasing due to age and obesity. Visfatin, a member of adipokines, is related to cancer progression and metastasis, but its relationship in PCa remains undetermined. In addition, no knowledge is available regarding relations between visfatin polymorphisms and clinicopathological characteristics in PCa.

pmc-11516325.title: Interventions to reduce loneliness in children and adolescents: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11516325.creator: L Burke
pmc-11516325.description: Despite the growing focus on adolescent loneliness and loneliness interventions, our understanding of successful approaches for tackling loneliness in childhood and adolescence remains limited. While recent reviews have made advances in exploring loneliness interventions for this age group, our understanding of successful approaches remains limited.

pmc-11638247.title: Neurobeachin regulates receptor downscaling at GABAergic inhibitory synapses in a protein kinase A-dependent manner
pmc-11638247.creator: Felix P Lützenkirchen, Yipeng Zhu, Hans M Maric, Dominik S Boeck, Kira V Gromova, Matthias Kneussel
pmc-11638247.description: GABAergic synapses critically modulate neuronal excitability, and plastic changes in inhibitory synaptic strength require reversible interactions between GABAA receptors (GABAARs) and their postsynaptic anchor gephyrin. Inhibitory long-term potentiation (LTP) depends on the postsynaptic recruitment of gephyrin and GABAARs, whereas the neurotransmitter GABA can induce synaptic removal of GABAARs.

pmc-11691347.title: TECHNOLOGY-RELATED COVID-19 EXPERIENCES OF OLDER VETERANS
pmc-11691347.creator: Saanvi Lamba, Pranjal Tyagi, Diana Ruiz, Stuti Dang
pmc-11691347.description: We fielded the HERO CARE survey to 20,000 community-dwelling Veterans from five Veterans Affairs’ (VA) Medical sites. Veterans were asked an open-ended question to “share anything else that you would like us to know about your experience with the COVID-19”. We received responses from 1,992 (95.8%) males and 88 (4.2%) female veterans; 23 responses were technology-related.

pmc-12460009.title: Trends in Prevalence of Yeast Species Associated With Urogenital Infection in Nsukka, Nigeria: An Overview of True Candida Species and Genotyping of Candida albicans hwp1-Heterozygous Isolates
pmc-12460009.creator: Eunice Ngozi Anaele, Josephine I. Okafor, Lucilla Lo Re, Carla Lo Passo, Francesco Mediati, Grazia Galeano, Orazio Romeo, Roberta Galbo, Letterio Giuffrè
pmc-12460009.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Pathogenic drug-resistant yeast species, associated with urogenital infections, are still not well-recognized in routine clinical laboratories. This study describes the prevalence and antifungal susceptibility profile of fungal species isolated from patients with urogenital infection in Nsukka, Nigeria. A total of 248 urogenital samples (voided urine, high vaginal swabs, urethral swabs, and semen) were cultured on specific mycological media for the isolation and presumptive identification of Candida and other yeast species.

pmc-12521614.title: Amino acid substitutions at rheostat positions in the Na+/taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide substrate channel have pleiotropic effects
pmc-12521614.creator: Liskin Swint‐Kruse, Melissa J. Ruggiero, Bruno Hagenbuch
pmc-12521614.description: In the human Na+/taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP), several non‐synonymous SNPs are known to have positive or negative medical consequences, and hundreds more are “variants of unknown significance.” One reason outcomes remain unknown is that computational predictions are not yet reliable. Such predictions are especially problematic for “rheostat” positions, where amino acid substitutions have widely varied outcomes.

pmc-12567168.title: Nutritional and Energy Profile of “No Added Sugar” Products Versus Their Conventional Counterparts on the Polish Food Market
pmc-12567168.creator: Aleksandra Kołodziejczyk, Justyna Nowak
pmc-12567168.description: Background/Objectives: The increasing presence of “no added sugar” products in the Polish food market provides consumers and nutritionists with access to products with varying nutritional compositions. Comparing the nutritional and energy values of products with and without added sugar provides objective data on their composition, which is important for informed diet planning and for monitoring differences between product groups.

pmc-12700491.title: A Clinical Case of Anti-synthetase Syndrome: Polysymptomatic and Underdiagnosed
pmc-12700491.creator: Nuno Oliveira, Francisco San Martin, Rosa Amorim
pmc-12700491.description: Antisynthetase syndrome (ASSD) encompasses a group of autoimmune diseases associated with the formation of antibodies against aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases (ARS). The medical literature describes a constellation of symptoms, including myositis, arthritis, Raynaud's phenomenon, interstitial lung disease (ILD), fever, skin rash, or "mechanic's hands.

pmc-13092867.title: Effects of orienteering exercise on spatial visualization ability in preschool children aged 4–5 years: Behavioral and fNIRS evidence
pmc-13092867.creator: Jiajia Yu, Yang Liu
pmc-13092867.description: Using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), this study examined cortical activation differences during a mental rotation task in 4–5-year-old children with varying levels of spatial visualization ability, and further compared the effects of Orienteering and Aerobic exercise in children with low spatial visualization ability.
